arStrings.szText: {c_important}Soul Shard{/c} Skills and their demons deal {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*100|%x|]{/c} damage. Casting a {c_important}Soul Shard{/c} Skill increases all your damage by {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"*100|x%|]{/c} for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} seconds, up to {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 2"*Affix."Static Value 0"*100|x%|]{/c}.
